operation.summary: Dry run: check an applet package and fill its blanks without storing or creating anything; returns exactly what the owner would review

body.name: package
body.description: The applet file itself: a bridgit-template/1 definition with runtime.adapter bridgit.package.v1 (legacy alias android.package.v1; see https://bridgit.cc/learn/builder/applet-packages.md)

body.name: url
body.description: Instead of package: an https://bridgit.cc/… package file (for example a recipe's applet.json)

body.name: template
body.description: Instead of package: a template registry key (with revision)

body.name: bundled
body.description: Instead of package/url/template: a built-in applet id (including a-sorta-fairytale-about-me, chef-helper, insurance-inventory, exercise-check); downloads its registry release

body.name: config
body.description: Values for the applet's blanks (config_schema); the rest use defaults. The owner can still change them on the review screen

operation.returns: valid, review{package_id, name, version, parts[] (plain words: what, how often, cost), permissions[{id, words}], blockers[], warnings[{code, where, says, fix}] (never block the install: card_request_too_big, card_reply_too_big, card_form_submit, card_storage, permission_unused, data_policy_contradicts, paid_without_cap), config, update}, package (the complete file: observation_schema, metrics, lifecycle, migration, data_policy, a missing permissions.required and asset sha256 filled in; publish this), data_contract, data_discovery, warnings[], or errors[]

template.description: Instead of package: a template registry key (with revision)
